verdict.rationale: Docs show a DNS API (create-record, list-records) that accepts type/host/value/TTL, implying multi-record-type support out of the box, and one community post even praises bulk DNS/nameserver changes. However, a hands-on long-time customer explicitly warns 'I just would point them somewhere else for DNS hosting,' a direct contradiction of the 'full DNS hosting comes with the domain' claim, so the community evidence concretely undercuts the vendor claim. Missing for 10: an explicit list of all supported record types, documented minimum/low TTL values, and any UI walkthrough or independent review of the DNS management dashboard's usability.
